adoption.notes: In v2.5.0-rc.10 and v2.5.0-rc.11 the HTTP exporter admitted only events typed sensor.reading while the poll loop and the firmware subscriber publish a reading as sensor.<sensor_type>, so it queued no reading unless a sensor's type was reading. From 2045efd it admits both and still writes sensor.reading in the batch. Neither has been exercised against a live receiver.

notes: The ingest consumer is outside the repositories these records track. The exporter states that delivery "follows" this contract, which does not state conformance; the version freezes by shipment in v2.5.0-rc.10.
